qualification: Isolated source changes on the committed baseline; broader pending main-tree work is preserved and excluded from this source qualification.

representation.node_policy: Existing NodeHost owns file/package resolution, real source reads and CommonJS module lifecycle. OXC and the shared VM own parsing, execution, guest objects, intrinsic JSON parsing and exception construction.
representation.module_cache: One active-engine cache, with legacy exports or shared rooted module records. Shared cache inserts before execution, reads current exports on hits, and evicts failures. Children and require.main project the module lifecycle; mainModule lives on the canonical process object.
representation.native_capture: Private native environment uses the existing traced Environment cell with named operation/data slots; no callback side map or new heap cell. Uncaptured callbacks retain the compact numeric operation environment.
representation.entry: CommonJS files execute during host initialization through the standard Node wrapper. .mjs and package type:module .js use OXC Module. Eval uses the existing realm with CommonJS globals; Script re-entry preserves roots and excludes caller lexical scope.
representation.removed: Duplicate descriptor validation during captured callback creation; no retained original-argument snapshots or wrapper registry added.
